description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: A unique identifier that you provide to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.en:
Specifies whether to enable Prometheus on the client. Valid values:

- true: Enables Prometheus.

- false: Disables Prometheus.
